frozenQuestion: At the observable S10 second-injury boundary, are full-population repeated-injury outcomes changed by the current arrangement, retained native policy state, retained movement-dependent fatigue, or their interactions?

inherits.postRecoveryStabilization: S01 charged two-opportunities-per-identity certificate capped at 20*n
inherits.sequenceAssignment: reuse exact S10 blocked assignment without reranking
inherits.eligibleControllers: native Bubble/Insertion/Selection plus S04 fatigue only; S07 memory, S08 plasticity, and S09 target-aware state are absent

population.estimandPopulation: all 384 exact S02 checkpoints with their exact S10 sequence assignments
population.resetBoundaryObservability: a reset is observable only after episode-1 completion, exact S01 stabilization, 20*n target-stable rest, and the matched second lesion; every earlier terminal remains a full-population competing terminal in every assigned arm

injuryContract.firstAndSecondInjury: repeat the exact S10 assigned segment reversal or equal-block transposition operator
injuryContract.firstInjuryFixture: must match the inherited S03 operator fixture exactly
injuryContract.secondInjuryBoundary: exact original target occupancy after stabilization and 20*n target-stable rest
injuryContract.preResetPairing: all ten arms must have the exact same post-second-lesion occupancy, native state, fatigue state, global event index, stream counters, and ledgers before any reset
injuryContract.severityPooling: operator-stratified; no scalar cross-operator severity equivalence

arrangement.reset: replace occupancy with a deterministic non-identical identity-conserving permutation having exactly the same direction-aware strict unequal inversion distance to the unchanged target
arrangement.matching: exact target distance, identity set, value multiset, cell count, target correspondence, and operator stratum
arrangement.streamOwnership: construction-only counter-addressed stream; never enters runtime stream counters

nativeState.reset: restore each Selection cursor exactly to the source S02 checkpoint snapshot
nativeState.excludedExecutionStateRule: always preserve; these fields provide chronology, random-address continuity, and accounting rather than a resettable cell-memory treatment

engineeredState.semantics: explicit empty partition because S07 was null, S08 modes were not validated and some were harmful, and S09 target-aware state is inapplicable to the unchanged target
engineeredState.reset: empty-to-empty audited no-op; no engineered state is silently promoted into S11

fatigue.preserved: retain the endogenous S04 state at the post-second-lesion reset boundary
fatigue.reset: restore the exact source-episode baseline: zero load for every identity and no residual cooldown
fatigue.classification: endogenous mediator kept separate from native policy state

alwaysPreserved: native and S04 process ledgers and audit history

arms.role: arrangement preserved and internal composite reset
arrangement reset and internal state preserved
both arrangement and internal composite reset
serialize and restore identical occupancy without consuming an opportunity or draw
serialize and restore identical native, empty engineered, and fatigue partitions without consuming an opportunity or draw

resetGateway.timing: instantaneous immediately after the matched second lesion and before the first recovery opportunity
resetGateway.supplementalAudit: record pre/post hash for every partition plus intended reads/writes and exact unchanged hashes for all protected state
resetGateway.shamRule: shams execute the same serialization boundary but write identical values and must be exactly behaviorally equivalent to factorial_a0_n0_f0

scrambleFeasibility.algorithm: counter-addressed constrained Lehmer-code sampling with exact inversion sum
scrambleFeasibility.required: candidate differs from the post-lesion occupancy and has exact target distance
scrambleFeasibility.infeasibleRule: record reset_infeasible_unique_distance_class and retain the assigned case; do not substitute a different distance, operator, time, or case
scrambleFeasibility.expectedMainPanel: all observable post-lesion reversal/transposition states have non-extreme target distance and are expected to be feasible

estimands.primaryPopulation: all assigned cases within each injury sequence, including competing terminals with joint success false and restricted episode-2 time fixed to the phase budget
estimands.compositeInteraction: difference-in-differences over the four corners crossing arrangement preserve/reset with internal composite preserve/reset (native and fatigue jointly)
estimands.orientation: reset minus preserved; negative restricted-time differences are beneficial and positive success differences are beneficial
estimands.conditionalAnalysis: reset-boundary-observed and episode-2-only summaries are supplementary and explicitly post-treatment selected
estimands.s10Anchor: factorial_a0_n0_f0 must exactly reproduce S10 prior_injury_retained_fatigue at rest_20n_v1 on shared fields

multiplicity.successTest: two-sided exact sign/binomial test on nonzero per-case factorial contrasts
multiplicity.timeTest: two-sided exact sign/binomial test on nonzero per-case restricted-time factorial contrasts
multiplicity.method: separate Holm adjustment over 14 prespecified sequence-by-factorial effects for success and restricted time
multiplicity.shamDecision: exact equality gate rather than a null-hypothesis test

outcomeRule.supportive: at least one multiplicity-adjusted factorial state contribution is detected with exact sham equivalence and all validation gates passing
outcomeRule.null: no adjusted factorial contribution is detected and all validation gates pass
outcomeRule.constraining: a reset invalidates the S10 operational learning anchor, a sham changes behavior, or another prespecified validation/interpretation boundary materially narrows the claim

claimBoundary: Structural memory, internal memory, fatigue, experience, hysteresis, and learning are operational simulator terms. Reset effects identify engineered interventions at the observable second-injury boundary only; they do not prove biological storage, learning, causal mediation, or explain first-stage eligibility differences that occur before the reset boundary.
